title: Biohub, a Mark Zuckerberg- and Priscilla Chan-funded institute, releases "a world model of protein biology" to researchers for prediction, design, and discovery (Ina Fried/Axios)
summary: Ina Fried / Axios: Biohub, a Mark Zuckerberg- and Priscilla Chan-funded institute, releases “a world model of protein biology” to researchers for prediction, design, and discovery — Biohub, the Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan-funded institute, on Wednesday released what it says amounts to “a world model of protein biology.”
contentText:
Ina Fried / Axios :

Biohub, a Mark Zuckerberg- and Priscilla Chan-funded institute, releases “a world model of protein biology” to researchers for prediction, design, and discovery   —  Biohub, the Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan-funded institute, on Wednesday released what it says amounts to “a world model of protein biology.”
